verdict.rationale: The docs confirm that dots support scheduled runs, since Pause "doesn't... cancel future scheduled runs". The dot is an always-on cloud agent that keeps working while your computer is off and reaches out with results, so recurring automated work that reports back is documented. Scheduling is shown only through a prompt example and a passing mention in the controls page, with no dedicated scheduling docs. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of how to create and manage schedules, explicit evidence of one-off tasks scheduled for a specific future time (as opposed to a recurring schedule), any schedule-management UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can schedule recurring or one-off tasks that run automatically and come back to me with results

citations.quote: It doesn't stop every delegated task or cancel future scheduled runs.
it reaches out with results or decisions that need you.
it can keep working even when your computer is off.
